messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — High 429/503 rate observed for hosted-inference us-west-2 cluster. Auto-page to oncall. Root cause unknown. Initial graph: 429s up ~x15 vs baseline, 503s appearing on inference-proxy. Timestamp 2026-03-15T12:04UTC.

alex k: oncall here, ack. pulling dashboards now — linking: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inf-prod/429-503-overview

mike_sre: seeing sudden increase in prefix-cache evictions and proxy 503s. Likely contention on KV cache + aggressive batching from a few tenants. Top offenders: tenant-id t-88, t-204 (embeddings-heavy). 429 spike from rate limiter at the edge?

alex k: checked edge qps histogram — p99 backpressure for /v1/embeddings up 4x. p95 latency for generation endpoints ~420ms. 429 rate ~18% across cluster, 503 ~6%.

irene-cse: customers reporting slower responses and some failed uploads. Tickets starting to surface from partner integrations. Marking high customer impact for the two big tenants.

mike_sre: propose surgical mitigations: 1) apply tenant-level hard cap (burst tokens) for t-88 and t-204; 2) throttle non-essential internal tooling routes; 3) temporarily disable streaming for long responses (reduce open connections); 4) fallback embeddings model to lower-throughput variant for those tenants.

alex k: agree. i'll apply tenant caps first and monitor. taking these commands:```bash
# reduce burst for tenant t-88 and t-204
redwoodctl tenants update t-88 --burst=50 --rate=30
redwoodctl tenants update t-204 --burst=40 --rate=25
# disable streaming for long responses globally (followup revert later)
redwoodctl config set inference.streaming.long_responses=false
```

(alex k): applied caps for t-88/t-204 at 12:09 UTC. applied streaming disable at 12:10 UTC. watching metrics.

mike_sre: also toggled short-circuit on non-critical /internal/score endpoint to reject >500 concurrent requests (fast fail). Command:```json
{"route":"/internal/score","max_concurrency":500}
```

deploy-bot: deploy event: configuration-change accepted by config-service (commit 7b2f3a). Rolling out to us-west-2.

alex k: quick observation after caps: within ~90s 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 7%. p95 latency improved ~120ms. 503s still present but trending down.

sasha-ops: good — can you add a temporary dashboard panel that slices 429s by tenant and route? I'll watch customer-facing endpoints and coordinate CS.

alex k: added panel and alerted irene-cse.

irene-cse: FYI reached out to top impacted partner, told them we're mitigating and expect degraded throughput for ~30-60m while we stabilize. no data loss, just retry/backoff advised.

mike_sre: next step: if 503s persist, we should evict aggressive KV caches (graceful) and enable per-route soft-rate limiting so clients get 429s earlier instead of proxy 503s. Also consider rolling back one recent kernel patch to proxy (deployed earlier today) if metrics don't normalize.

alex k: agree. standing by to roll that back; need approval from eng-runtime. pinging @mike_sre to run rollback if needed.

(12:18 UTC) alex k: 429 now 3.2%, 503 1.1%. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inf-prod/429-503-overview?from=12:00&to=12:30

mike_sre: looks promising. leaving streaming disabled for 30m and keeping tenant caps. set a reminder to revert streaming flag in 30m if stable.

alex k: creating short incident note in incidents channel and starting a concise timeline for handoff.

sasha-ops: i'm coming online in 20m to take the handoff. please include current mitigations and the revert checklist.

alex k: handoff checklist (copied into thread):
- tenant caps applied to t-88/t-204 (burst/rate values)
- streaming disabled for long responses (config key inference.streaming.long_responses=false)
- internal route /internal/score short-circuited max_concurrency=500
- dashboards: 429-by-tenant, 503-by-proxy, p95 latency per route added
- contact: irene-cse handling customer comms
- revert path: redwoodctl tenants update <id> --burst=<orig> --rate=<orig>; redwoodctl config set inference.streaming.long_responses=true; remove short-circuit via redwoodctl routes update /internal/score --max_concurrency=unbounded

sasha-ops: ack, i'll take the pager at 12:35 UTC. will keep pages open if 429>5% for >10m or 503>2% for >5m.

(12:28 UTC) alex k: metrics holding. 429 2.7%, 503 0.9%. noted one downstream partner retry storm — adding a rate-limit hint in proxied responses to encourage exponential backoff. small header addition: `Retry-After` for 429.

mike_sre: leaving a note: follow-up actions post-incident: 1) run tenant-level traffic replay to reproduce and tune caps; 2) create automated detection to break out tenants driving >X% of 429s; 3) investigate cache eviction pattern causing 503s. adding tickets.

irene-cse: will bundle a customer-impact summary for ops review: affected tenants, start/end times, mitigations applied, recommended customer guidance.

alex k: closing active mitigation for now; segued to monitoring mode. handoff to sasha-ops at 12:35 UTC. will remain available if needed. :thumbsup:

sasha-ops: taking over. thanks team. I'll document timeline and escalate if any regression. (reacted with :eyes:)
